product.name: Strategy & Planning

product.name: Customer Success
product.description: A program focused on proactive customer engagement, churn analysis, and continuous improvement to maintain long-term user retention.

product.description: A subscription service granting access to experienced sales talent with a track record of delivering results, ready to integrate quickly into client operations.
